items.title: Breaking: Famed mountaineer Nirmal Purja confirmed dead in Pakistan avalanche
items.description: The Netflix-famous climber died, among nine others, climbing the world's 12th highest mountain.

items.title: Wildfires force mass evacuations in Europe as Australia sends help
items.description: Hundreds of thousands of people were evacuated in France this week, as fires continue to grip Europe.

items.title: Russian missile attacks on Kyiv kill at least nine and injure dozens
items.description: Ukraine downed only one of 27 Russian ballistic missiles during the attack as the country lacks interceptors for the US Patriot systems, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said.

items.title: 'We are not a monoculture and never have been,' Penny Wong tells Garma Festival
items.description: On the second day of Garma Festival, Foreign Minister Penny Wong emphasised the strategic importance of ties between First Nations peoples and Australia's Pacific neighbours.

items.title: Live: Aussie gold medallist admits to 'selfish' tactics, Diamonds face massive test
items.description: Australian race walk gold medallist Jemima Montag makes no apologies for a "selfish" race plan, sitting behind teammate Elizabeth McMillen for most of the 10,000m race before burning past her late. Follow live.

items.title: Italy takes 'extraordinary' action after Ceuta migrant rush
items.description: An estimated 50,000 migrants crossed from Morocco into the Spanish enclave of Ceuta in chaotic scenes that left dozens dead. Here's what happened and why the crisis has prompted parts of Europe to tighten its borders.

items.title: My cousin was sucked into a fatal alternative therapy 'wormhole', says author
items.description: Author Hannah McElhinney spent years investigating after her cousin Lauren died seeking controversial medical treatment overseas.

items.title: Broncos to 'look after each other' as title defence comes to early end
items.description: The Brisbane Broncos will become the first reigning premier in 20 years to miss the NRL finals, after their faint hopes of playing in the playoffs ended with defeat to the Newcastle Knights on Saturday.

items.title: Live: Blues record monster win against Lions as Giants survive Port comeback
items.description: Carlton's wildcard bid receives a huge boost after a comprehensive win over Brisbane as GWS picks up a hard-fought road win against Port Adelaide. Follow live.

items.title: 'Mini-Mamdanis' spark renewed Republican tactic ahead of midterms
items.description: President Trump has reignited anti-communist rhetoric as "mini-Mamdanis" continue to challenge the centrist Democrat establishment.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
